nodes.title: Learning's reward is the outcome that counts (verified, then a person's label, then a trusted AI read), read through calls' outcome.readings, never calls' tables. Every experiment progress and result says where its outcomes came from ('38 verified, 12 labelled by a person, 112 AI-read; 40 AI reads not counted'), and planning scales by that mix: an AI read at agreement a counts as (2a-1)^2 of a true label (labelAdjustedPlan).
nodes.rationale: outcome.import (99c0924) gives businesses verified outcomes from their own files. A result must say how much of it rests on them, and fewer, truer labels prove more per call.
nodes.reverse_if: Calls exposes graded outcomes another way (e.g. a view); then read that instead of outcome.readings.

nodes.title: When verified outcomes and AI reads disagree on more than 15% of 20+ calls in an experiment, the result carries a warning and each disagreeing judge gets calibration status 'needs_recheck' through calls' judge.flag_recheck (a new row; history kept). The calls it read are refreshed, so its reads stop counting until judge.calibrate passes again.
nodes.rationale: A judge that verified outcomes contradict cannot keep feeding experiments on the strength of an older calibration.
nodes.reverse_if: Calibration gains a continuous agreement check against verified outcomes in calls itself; then learning only reports.

nodes.title: The integrator asked for 'the AI read otherwise' as the reward. Learning keeps decision.2026-10-21.learning-counts-outcome-calls (blueprint F4): an AI read counts only when its judge is trusted; untrusted reads are reported as 'not counted'. Should untrusted AI reads ever be a reward (e.g. with the power penalty from labelAdjustedPlan)? Owner's call.
nodes.closes_when: The owner confirms F4 for experiments, or directs that untrusted reads count (one line in calls' refreshOutcome, plus a supersedes edge).

events.details: Experiments read rewards by source through calls' new outcome.readings, warn and flag a judge for re-check when AI reads disagree with verified outcomes (above 15% on 20+ calls), and plan power by the label mix. Untrusted AI reads stay uncounted (F4); routed to the owner as an open question.
